description: This file defines the interface and implementation for a Timer class and a TimerFactory class within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to timer functionality, including creation, cancellation, and activity status checks.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Timer instances, implementing the ITimerFactory interface.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a timer that can be started, canceled, and queried for activity status, implementing the ITimer interface.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer instance with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the timer if it is active.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.
